_about: This is the complete persistent, non-secret VANTARI configuration surface. Keys beginning with an underscore are documentation metadata and do not change runtime behavior.
VANTARI_HOME is intentionally not configurable here because it locates this file. Set it in the launching process when the default ~/.vantari directory must change.
Provider credentials, provider identity, base URL, model, account metadata, and the active provider belong in the sibling auth.json file and are never accepted here.
Host and port, per-turn context/output overrides, tool timeouts, and output caps are invocation-scoped controls; they remain CLI, RPC, or tool arguments rather than persistent global policy.
Precedence is invocation argument, process environment, config.json environment entry, typed config section, then the compiled default where that layer applies.

_help.version: Configuration schema version. Version 1 is the only supported value; change it only when migrating to a schema explicitly supported by the installed binary.

_help.workspace: Optional persistent workspace path used when no VANTARI_WORKSPACE process or environment entry is set and no workspace is discovered from the current directory. Null keeps automatic discovery.
_help.max_steps: Maximum agent execution steps allowed in one run. Raise deliberately for long autonomous work; lower it to bound cost and runaway loops.
_help.max_tool_calls_per_turn: Maximum tool calls accepted from a single provider turn. This limits oversized or cyclic tool batches before effects execute.
_help.max_tool_calls_per_session: Maximum cumulative tool calls across one session. It is the session-wide safety budget and must be at least as large as the per-turn limit.

_help.wire_api: Provider HTTP protocol shape: chat_completions for OpenAI-compatible /v1/chat/completions, responses for /v1/responses, or anthropic_messages for /v1/messages. This does not select credentials or a model.

_help.auto_compaction: Allows the context compiler to create checkpoints automatically near the configured token threshold. The append-only transcript remains intact.
_help.manual_compaction: Allows explicit operator-triggered session compaction. Disable only when checkpoint writes must be prohibited entirely.
_help.context_window_tokens: Provider context capacity in tokens. Null enables provider/model detection with the compiled default as fallback; a positive integer pins the capacity.
_help.compact_at_ratio_milli: Automatic compaction threshold in thousandths of usable context capacity. 850 means 85 percent; valid values are 1 through 1000.
_help.reserve_output_tokens: Tokens held back from input context for the next model output. It also becomes the default maximum output budget unless a turn supplies an explicit override.
_help.keep_recent_messages: Minimum number of newest transcript messages retained verbatim after a compacted checkpoint so current conversational state remains precise.
_help.max_entries_per_checkpoint: Maximum transcript entries summarized into one checkpoint. Zero means no entry-count cap; token and lifecycle boundaries still apply.
_help.aggressiveness_milli: Compaction strength in thousandths. Higher values produce denser summaries; valid values are 0 through 1000.
_help.retry_on_provider_overflow: When true, a provider context-overflow response may trigger one compiler rebuild and retry through the canonical checkpoint path.

_help.system_prompt_file: Optional workspace-relative path to an additional non-empty system prompt file. Null uses only the kernel-owned system prompt.
_help.developer_prompt_file: Optional workspace-relative path to an additional non-empty developer prompt file. Null supplies no operator-managed developer prompt.

_help.enabled: Loads bounded active session and global memories into the agent prompt. False preserves the files and tools but disables automatic recall.
_help.agent_writes_enabled: Allows memory_write calls initiated by the agent or an explicit user request. False makes memory read-only to agent runs.
_help.max_entry_bytes: Maximum UTF-8 bytes in one topic plus content payload. This prevents memory from becoming a transcript or document store.
_help.max_session_context_bytes: Maximum bytes of active session-only memory compiled into one provider prompt rebuild.
_help.max_global_context_bytes: Maximum bytes of active cross-workspace memory compiled into one provider prompt rebuild.
_help.max_context_entries: Maximum combined active memory entries compiled into one provider prompt rebuild. Session entries are considered before global entries.

_help.VANTARI_WORKSPACE: File-backed equivalent of the VANTARI_WORKSPACE process variable. A real process variable with the same name wins; null leaves this layer unset.
_help.MAX_STEPS: File-backed environment-style override for runtime.max_steps. Accepts a positive integer or decimal string; the real MAX_STEPS process variable wins.
_help.MAX_TOOL_CALLS_PER_TURN: File-backed environment-style override for runtime.max_tool_calls_per_turn. Accepts a positive integer or decimal string; the real process variable wins.
_help.MAX_TOOL_CALLS_PER_SESSION: File-backed environment-style override for runtime.max_tool_calls_per_session. Accepts an integer or decimal string at least as large as the effective per-turn limit; the real process variable wins.
